verdict.rationale: The evidence publishes fees and processing times for online versus paper filing, such as 1 day or 4-hour express service. These are turnaround times, not operating-hours windows, per-day submission limits or session timeouts for the Online Filing Centre. Nothing in the pack shows such usage constraints being disclosed before a founder starts.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
